mission: 'ERA runs talent programmes for researchers and entrepreneurs working to understand and mitigate risks from frontier AI, based at Cambridge, UK.' Its fellowship covers technical safety, technical AI governance, frontier AI security and AI×biosecurity; the next ERA:AI Fellowship runs 18 Jan – 26 Mar 2027. It says 200+ alumni work at places like the UK AI Security Institute, EU AI Office, CAISI, RAND, GovAI, METR, Apollo, Anthropic and Google DeepMind. Founded by Nandini Shiralkar (originally as the Cambridge Existential Risks Initiative); founding year approximate.

key_work.title: ERA:AI Research Fellowship
key_work.plain_summary: A paid, mentored research fellowship in Cambridge for people working on frontier-AI risk.

key_work.title: ERA–KASL AI Safety Internship
key_work.plain_summary: A joint paid research internship with the Krueger AI Safety Lab at Cambridge on technical and governance AI safety.

warnings.text: Increasingly capable AI systems create risks that need dedicated research, talent and organisations to understand and reduce (mission).

recommendations.text: Accelerate talent, advance research and help build organisations working on frontier-AI risk (mission).
